expedition.command.move.build_height: The box would leave the build height of %s.
expedition.command.move.dry_run.clear: Dry run: the move would go ahead, carrying %s blocks and %s block entities, mass %s. Nothing was changed.
expedition.command.move.dry_run.refused: Dry run: the move would be refused, with %s obstacles. Nothing was changed.
expedition.command.move.entities_left: %s entities in the box stayed behind: their teleport was refused.
expedition.command.move.failed: The move failed part-way through: %s. The server log has the details.
expedition.command.move.moved: Moved the box to %s in %s: %s blocks, %s block entities and %s entities, mass %s, in %s ticks (%s ms of work).
expedition.command.move.nowhere: The box would go nowhere: its lowest corner is already at %s.
expedition.command.move.refused: The move was refused, and nothing was changed: %s (%s)
expedition.command.move.started: Moving the box at %s to %s in %s. The result follows when the move is done.
expedition.command.planet.validate.chang: The files differ from the planets loaded now. /reload loads them.
expedition.command.planet.validate.summa: Checked %s planet files: %s planets would load, %s files wouldn't, and there are %s warnings. Nothing was changed.
expedition.configuration.border.tooltip: World borders at each planet's edge, with chunks far past them left empty. The border is centred on the planet's surface.center, space.size blocks a side. Chunks already generated are never changed.
expedition.configuration.borderEnabled.t: Give every planet a world border at its square's edge, and leave chunks far past it empty.
expedition.configuration.endPortals.tool: Whether an End portal takes anything into the End. Off, the portal does nothing going in, and a ship is the only way there. Leaving the End by portal always works.
expedition.configuration.exclude.tooltip: Planets, by dimension id, left without a border even when planets are bounded, such as minecraft:overworld.
expedition.configuration.flights.tooltip: How long trips take, and where ships may land.
expedition.configuration.gasAirBreathing: The partial pressure of oxidisers behind the nozzle, in kPa, at which a thruster breathes the air and needs no oxidiser from its tanks. The Overworld's air has 21.
expedition.configuration.gasEfficiency.t: Momentum (mass × blocks per second) per unit of fuel. A trip burns 2 × mass × cruise speed ÷ efficiency. A unit is a mole of hydrogen; methane gives 3.3.
The share of the burn's heat left behind the nozzle, 0 to 1. The rest leaves with the jet.
expedition.configuration.gasExhaustTempe: The exhaust's temperature as it leaves the nozzle, in kelvin.
expedition.configuration.gasThrust.toolt: Thrust, in weight on the Overworld: 400 lifts a ship of mass 400 there at a thrust-to-weight of 1. Taking off and landing need more than 1.
expedition.configuration.gasThruster.too: Burns a fuel gas with an oxidiser from the tanks beside it. High thrust, low efficiency, low top speed.
expedition.configuration.gasTopSpeed.too: In blocks per second. Above it the thruster stays cold.
The most blocks a ship's box may be along any one axis. 64 is the largest size that has been measured; a longer side spans more chunks.
expedition.configuration.maxOverlappingH: The most blocks a ship's box may hold for a short hop, a move onto part of its own space. Such a hop is done in one server tick: a full 16×16×16 box costs that tick about 6–10 ms, and every 4,096 blocks more adds about as much.
expedition.configuration.maxUnevenness.t: The most the ground under a ship's footprint may vary, in blocks, for it to land there.
expedition.configuration.maxVolume.toolt: The most blocks a ship's box may hold, air included. The default, 131,072, is 64×64×32: a full ship that size takes about 3 s a trip. 64×64×64 works, but takes about 6 s a trip and can bring lag spikes on a small heap.
expedition.configuration.netherPortals.t: Whether a Nether portal takes anything into the Nether. Off, the portal still lights but does nothing going in, and a ship is the only way there. Leaving the Nether by portal always works.
expedition.configuration.portals.tooltip: Nether and End portals. Both work as in vanilla by default. Turned off, entering one does nothing; leaving the Nether or the End by portal always works.
expedition.configuration.ships.tooltip: The server's ceiling on a ship's box. This is a technical limit, not a game rule: it keeps one move from stalling the server. Raising it makes the largest moves longer and heavier on memory.
expedition.configuration.tripTimeMultipl: Scales every trip's time in transit. At 0.2, a well-powered ship takes about a minute to the Moon and about 5 minutes to the Nether.
expedition.configuration.voidMargin.tool: Blocks of terrain kept past a planet's border. Chunks wholly beyond are left empty. -1 keeps terrain everywhere.
expedition.configuration.warmUpSeconds.t: How long the drives warm up before a launch, in seconds.
expedition.flight.fallback: The ship couldn't land (%s), so it is going into orbit over %s instead.
expedition.flight.fallback.unknown: Your ship couldn't land where it was going, so it is going into orbit above the site instead.
expedition.move.limit.hop_volume: The ship's box holds %s blocks; this server allows %s for a hop onto its own space (%s over).
expedition.move.limit.longest_side: The ship's box is %s blocks along its longest side; this server allows %s (%s over).
expedition.move.limit.volume: The ship's box holds %s blocks; this server allows %s (%s over).
expedition.move.refusal.atmos_busy: The air inside is already being moved by something else.
expedition.move.refusal.atmos_ended: The atmosphere simulation dropped the move before it began; try again.
expedition.move.refusal.atmos_paused: The air inside is paused, because part of it isn't loaded.
expedition.move.refusal.atmos_timed_out: The atmosphere simulation timed out before the move began; try again.
expedition.move.refusal.atmos_too_large: The rooms inside hold more air than this server can move at once.
expedition.move.refusal.atmos_unloaded: Part of the air inside isn't loaded.
expedition.move.refusal.blocked: Something is in the way at the destination.
expedition.move.refusal.busy: Part of this space is already being moved.
expedition.move.refusal.claimed: You may not build on part of the land the ship leaves or lands on: it is protected or claimed.
expedition.move.refusal.handover_failed: The move couldn't be handed over to the atmosphere simulation.
expedition.move.refusal.hop_too_large: The ship is too large for a hop onto its own space on this server. Move it further, clear of itself.
expedition.move.refusal.immovable: The ship holds a block that can't be moved.
expedition.move.refusal.landing_reserved: Another ship is due to arrive there.
expedition.move.refusal.launching: The ship is already counting down to launch.
expedition.move.refusal.no_drive: The ship has no drive with an open nozzle.
expedition.move.refusal.no_fuel: The tanks hold less fuel than the trip burns. Fly slower, or fill up.
expedition.move.refusal.no_ground: There's no ground to land on there, or no room above it.
expedition.move.refusal.no_planet: There's no way there: the destination isn't a planet you can fly to, or the ship isn't on a planet or in Space.
expedition.move.refusal.not_owner: Only the ship's owner or an operator may launch it.
expedition.move.refusal.out_of_range: The trip would take longer than this server allows. Fly faster, or somewhere closer.
expedition.move.refusal.no_destination: The destination's dimension isn't on this server.
expedition.move.refusal.outside_border: The destination is outside the world border.
expedition.move.refusal.server_stopping: The server stopped before the move began.
expedition.move.refusal.ship_overlap: Another ship's box overlaps this one, so neither can move.
expedition.move.refusal.thrust_too_low: The ship's thrust can't lift its weight here.
expedition.move.refusal.thrust_too_low_t: The ship's thrust couldn't hold up its weight at the destination, so it couldn't land.
expedition.move.refusal.too_large: The ship is larger than this server allows.
expedition.move.refusal.too_uneven: The ground at the landing spot is too uneven to land on.
expedition.move.refusal.transit_too_tall: The ship is taller than the transit dimension.
expedition.move.refusal.unloaded: Part of the ship or its destination isn't loaded.
expedition.planet.problem.air_required: is needed unless vacuum is true
expedition.planet.problem.at_least: is %s, but must be at least %s
expedition.planet.problem.border_at_next: the world border of this planet's level differs from what the file and [planets.border] give now. Borders apply when the server starts and when expedition-server.toml is reloaded
expedition.planet.problem.min_above_max: the first number, %s, is above the second, %s
expedition.planet.problem.no_pressure: the partial pressures add up to 0 kPa. For a surface with no air, set vacuum to true instead
expedition.planet.problem.not_boolean: must be true or false, not %s
expedition.planet.problem.not_id: "%s" isn't an id, such as mypack:kepler
expedition.planet.problem.not_integer: must be a whole number, not %s
expedition.planet.problem.not_pair: must be two whole numbers, [a, b], not %s
expedition.planet.problem.not_string: must be a string in quotes, not %s
expedition.planet.problem.not_temperatur: must be a temperature in kelvin, or { "day": ..., "night": ... }, not %s
expedition.planet.problem.out_of_range: is %s, but must be from %s to %s
expedition.planet.problem.overlap: the square in Space overlaps the square of %s, in %s. Neither planet loads
expedition.planet.problem.parent_loop: the parents go round in a loop: %s
expedition.planet.problem.regions_past_b: %s region files of %s lie wholly more than %s blocks past the world border. The chunks already in them stay as they are; only chunks generated from now on are left empty
expedition.planet.problem.reserved_dimen: %s is one of Expedition's own dimensions, which can't be a planet
expedition.planet.problem.same_dimension: %s is also the dimension of %s. Neither planet loads
expedition.planet.problem.space_outside: the square reaches past the edge of Space, ±%s
expedition.planet.problem.structures_at_: differs from the lists this planet's level was built with. Structure lists apply when the server starts, so these take effect at the next start
expedition.planet.problem.unknown_catego: %s isn't a mob category. The categories are: %s
expedition.planet.problem.unknown_dimens: %s isn't a dimension on this server, so the planet can't be reached
expedition.planet.problem.unknown_field: isn't a field here. The fields are: %s
expedition.planet.problem.unknown_gas: %s isn't a gas ZAS³ defines on this server, so the planet doesn't load
expedition.planet.problem.unknown_struct: %s isn't a structure or a structure set
%s isn't a structure tag or a structure-set tag
expedition.portal.end_off: End portals are turned off on this server: only a ship can reach the End.
expedition.portal.nether_off: Nether portals are turned off on this server: only a ship can reach the Nether.
expedition.shuttle_computer.fit.done: Fitted the box to %s connected blocks.
expedition.shuttle_computer.fit.too_larg: The blocks joined to the computer run past this server's ceiling on a ship's box, so the box wasn't changed. Set it by hand.
expedition.shuttle_computer.fit.tooltip: Grow or shrink the box to the blocks joined to the computer, face to face. Natural ground, fluids and plants aren't followed.
expedition.shuttle_computer.flight.launc: Only the ship's owner or an operator may launch it.
expedition.shuttle_computer.name: Ship name
expedition.shuttle_computer.overlap: The box overlaps the ship %s. Two ships whose boxes overlap can't move.
expedition.shuttle_computer.terrain: The box holds %s blocks of natural ground. They will move with the ship, and count toward its mass.
expedition.transit.no_building: Nothing can be built outside the ship in transit.
expedition.transit.stepped_outside: You stepped outside the ship, into Space.
